requirements: R1: Implement autocomplete and typo correction in DocumentSearchController

slices.title: Patch DocumentSearchController for autocomplete suggestions
slices.jtbd: When implementing backend autocomplete for this epic, I want to add suggestions and typo correction to DocumentSearchController, so that real-time auto-suggestions can use real server data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query fragment
When the frontend requests suggestions
Then the DocumentSearchController should return a list of auto-complete suggestions and typo corrections
And tests should verify this behavior to guarantee coverage
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce search failure rate from 15% to 5% by providing server-side suggestions

requirements: R1: Log search events with the query via AnalyticsService in DocumentSearchController
R2: Implement pagination for search results in KnowledgeBase.svelte frontend

slices.title: Patch DocumentSearchController to log search events
slices.jtbd: When implementing search analytics for this epic, I want to log search queries in DocumentSearchController, so that popular search requests are recorded.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user searching for documents
When the search is performed
Then the DocumentSearchController should log the SEARCH event with the query via AnalyticsService
And unit tests should verify the logging invocation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase search observability logging coverage from 0% to 100% of queries

slices.title: Patch KnowledgeBase.svelte for search pagination
slices.jtbd: When implementing search pagination for this epic, I want to support page navigation in KnowledgeBase.svelte, so that users can browse large document sets.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search result with many documents
When the user scrolls or clicks next
Then the frontend should load and display the next set of results
And UI tests should verify pagination behavior
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce search results render time for large sets from >2000ms to <500ms

requirements: R1: Verify user role permissions for specific document access in FileDownloadController

slices.title: Patch FileDownloadController for document access authorization
slices.jtbd: When implementing document authorization for this epic, I want to verify role permissions in FileDownloadController, so that unauthorized downloads are blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user requesting to download a file
When they provide the document ID
Then FileDownloadController should verify if the user's role allows access to that document
And return an error if access is denied, verified by security tests
slices.tocConstraintRef: Missing authorization check on file download
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Eliminate unauthorized document downloads from >0 to 0 events per month

requirements: R1: Update task status logic to prevent marking as done when PR is closed without merge

slices.title: Patch internal system for accurate GitHub PR outcome tracking
slices.jtbd: When implementing task status sync for this epic, I want to accurately map GitHub PR closed states, so that tasks aren't falsely marked as done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task linked to a PR
When the PR is closed without being merged
Then the internal system should not mark the task as done
And integration tests should verify this state transition
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive done tasks in GitHub sync from 5% to 0%
